dz: 忏悔者爱德华于前一天去世后，Witan 召开会议确认哈罗德·戈德温森为新英格兰国王；哈罗德于同一天加冕，引发了一场继承危机，最终导致诺曼征服英格兰。
de: Following the death of Edward the Confessor on the previous day, the Witan meets to confirm Harold Godwinson as the new King of England; Harold is crowned the same day, sparking a succession crisis that will eventually lead to the Norman conquest of England.
